                      RESULT OF THE POST-AUCTION OPTION FACILITY  4⅛% TREASURY GILT 2033




An  additional                      £999.999 million  nominal  of                            4⅛  %  Treasury  Gilt                         2033 (ISIN  Code:                  GB00BVP99780)  will  be  created  for  settlement
on       26 August              2026 in   respect   of   the   amount   purchased   by   the   Gilt                                                            -edged   Market   Makers   and   investors   during   the
Post-Auction Option Facility.

This additional stock will be sold at the average accepted price of                                                                                               £96.464 and will take the total amount outstanding of                                                                  4⅛%
Treasury Gilt 2033 to £30,685,599,000.00 nominal.
